role: The four 1.7.10 noise generators: NoiseGeneratorImproved (Perlin with the per-y-cell corner reuse), NoiseGeneratorOctaves (3D and 2D, with the 16777216 wrap), NoiseGeneratorSimplex (array and single-point forms) and NoiseGeneratorPerlin (octaves of simplex). Every worldgen density, surface, biome-colour and lake noise draws from here.

structs.name: GX, GY, GZ, G2X, G2Z (static const tables)
structs.java: NoiseGeneratorImproved's gradient tables field_152381_e..field_152385_i, as used by grad and func_76309_a

gpu: lines 104-171, function improved_add: the 3D path caches corner gradients across iterations while the integer y cell repeats (last_y, c0..c3), a loop-carried dependence a per-cell GPU thread cannot split without recomputing; results must stay bit-identical
line 189 and line 335, functions octaves_3d and perlin_2d: out arrays are caller-owned; no allocation here, but sizes are unchecked (xs*ys*zs up to the caller)
notes: Pure functions over caller state; no globals, no allocation, loops bounded by the arguments. It is on the tick path only because chunk generation runs when the tick loads a chunk. The simplex point form uses no generator offsets, matching func_151605_a. Test list is from which tests reach worldgen (terrain, surface, nether, end), not from a direct include of noise.h; not verified member by member against the Java names of the gradient tables.
